messages:
Nadia (AM): Hey team — ClarusAI just sent a vendor security questionnaire + a DPA addendum. Key asks: SOC2 report, EU data residency, KMS/customer-managed keys, subprocessor list, and an architecture diagram. They want answers by EOD Wednesday.

Priya (Security): Thanks. Quick answers/notes: 1) SOC2: current report available (I'll attach). 2) Data residency: EU hosting available for Dedicated/Private; Hosted API can be served from EU regions for eligible tenants — need to confirm their account type. 3) KMS: customer-managed keys supported on Private; Dedicated can integrate with KMS/HSM. Hosted uses managed keys by default; enterprise CSE options are a conversation. 4) Subprocessors: we have a standard list I'll attach. 5) Arch diagram: we maintain a sanitized vendor-facing diagram.

Tom (Onboarding): I'll book a short call with ClarusAI to confirm environment and timeline. @Nadia can you upload the questionnaire PDF here?

Nadia (AM): Uploading now: <https://redwood.internal/docs/uploads/clarusai_questionnaire_198765.pdf>

Priya (Security): I'll draft canned answers and redact any infra specifics. Also need to know if they plan to send production data in first 30 days — that changes the gating checklist.

Claus (Customer Success Bot): SOC2 report (2025) uploaded: <https://redwood.internal/compliance/soc2-2025.pdf> :white_check_mark:

Jorge (CS Ops): Pulling subprocessor list + sanitized arch — ETA today 4pm PT.

Priya (Security): If they insist on Hosted + CSE we need to evaluate feasibility quickly; otherwise recommend Dedicated/Private for EU+KMS. Suggest we offer a staged canary migration plan.

Nadia (AM): Customer said they prefer hosted but are open to Dedicated. Proposed reply: include SOC2, subprocessor list, sanitized diagram, ask about production data timing and deployment preference. I'll draft the message.

Tom (Onboarding): Call scheduled Mon 09:30 PT with ClarusAI (calendar invite sent). Agenda: residency, KMS flow, timeline for data onboarding.

Nadia (AM): Draft reply below — please review quickly:

---
Hi Clara and team,

Thanks for the questionnaire. Attached are our SOC2 report, subprocessor list, and a sanitized architecture diagram. For data residency, we can provide EU residency on Dedicated/Private or in specific Hosted regions depending on account settings — could you confirm which deployment you intend to use? For KMS/customer-managed keys, we support them on Private and Dedicated; Hosted API uses managed keys by default but enterprise options can be discussed. Do you anticipate ingesting production data within the first 30 days? If so, we recommend a short security onboarding call and a staged ingestion plan.

Best,
Nadia
---

Priya (Security): LGTM. Tiny wording tweak: change 'we can provide EU residency on Dedicated/Private' -> 'we can provide EU residency on Dedicated/Private or in select Hosted regions' :+1:

Jorge (CS Ops): Sending subprocessor list and sanitized diagram now: <https://redwood.internal/docs/clarusai_subprocessors.pdf> <https://redwood.internal/diagrams/clarusai_sanitized_arch.png>

Nadia (AM): Sent to customer. They replied: "Thanks — receiving docs. Can we get a more detailed KMS flow (how keys are stored/rotated, and what we can control)?"

Priya (Security): I'll create a short KMS flow appendix and an appendix describing options (managed keys vs customer-managed). ETA tomorrow noon.

Tom (Onboarding): Noting a potential renewal/onboarding risk: if they require Hosted + full CSE fast, procurement for Dedicated/Private may slow timeline and affect go-live. @Nadia please capture in opportunity notes.

Nadia (AM): Done. Added risk tag `residency-kms` to the account and flagged for AE follow-up.

Jorge (CS Ops): Closing loop — deliverables list: SOC2 link, subprocessor.pdf, sanitized_arch.png (delivered), KMS_flow_appendix (Priya). Owner: Priya for KMS appendix. Target: customer confirmation by next Thu.

Priya (Security): Will post the KMS appendix as a short Gist + attach to the thread once ready.

Nadia (AM): Thanks all. :pray:
